tools.name: get_firm_details
tools.description: Who Rayon Insurance is, where it is licensed, what it does and does not do, and how to contact it. Call this before telling a visitor Rayon can help.

tools.name: list_request_forms
tools.description: The kinds of request Rayon takes and the web page where a visitor can fill in each one themselves. Use it to pick the kind for submit_request, or to send the visitor to the form instead.

tools.name: submit_request

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_request_forms · Private data: get_firm_details, submit_request · Public sink: list_request_forms, submit_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_request_forms · Private data: get_firm_details, submit_request · Public sink: list_request_forms, submit_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
